Incident Bot: PagerDuty alert -> P12345: elevated 5xx + latency in hosted API (eu-west-1). Primary: Maria C. Escalation policy: page primary then secondary. Details: https://pd.redwood.internal/incidents/P12345
Maria C: I'm looking. seeing spikes on gw-eu-3 and model-worker-7. starting quick triage, collecting logs and histograms.
Aj P: I'll shadow as secondary. pulling logs and metrics dashboard. lmK if you want me to grab traces.
Maria C: quick customer impact: subset of hosted API customers on dedicated pools may see increased latency ~200-600ms and occasional 502s. not widespread but affecting sustained throughput.
Devon R: If you need me to take over later I can swap into primary. scheduled to be reachable in ~25m.
Maria C: heads up, I need a 20m break in ~10m. @Devon R would you be able to take primary at ~16:05 UTC if it's still ongoing? @Aj P can you confirm secondary?
Aj P: ack — I'll be secondary. will run the primary-handoff checklist when swap happens: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-handoff (see "swap checklist")
Maria C: current mitigations tried: restarted model-worker-7 (no immediate effect), restarted gw-eu-3 (partial reduction in 5xx), increased logging level for kv-cache. no config rollbacks yet.
Devon R: I'll plan to take primary. initiating handoff: Maria, please paste the last three commands you ran and any wip notes.
Maria C: commands: `kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/gw-eu-3`, `systemctl restart model-worker-7`, `tail -n 200 /var/log/model-worker-7/errors.log`. note: saw repeated `OOM while allocating` entries at 15:42 UTC — could be GC/quant scheduling.
Incident Bot: Incident status changed to "Acknowledged" by Devon R.
Devon R: I'm primary now. verified traffic routing and KV cache states. applying a temporary mitigation: increase batch timeout to 150ms on gw-eu-3 to reduce backpressure (rolling config).
Aj P: running canary deploy of timeout change across 10% of gw-eu-3 instances now. monitoring error rate and p50/p95 latency.
Maria C: leaving a handover note in the incident room — error spike seems correlated with a model rollout around 15:30 UTC, could be an incompatible kernel pick.
Devon R: good catch. I'll check the rollout CI and kernel logs. if confirmed, we'll fallback to previous model build and re-evaluate.
Samir: noted rotation update in PagerDuty: Maria C -> Devon R primary at 16:05 UTC, Aj P secondary. No coverage gap flagged.
Devon R: mitigation rolled to 100% on gw-eu-3, error rate dropped ~60% and latency improving. will keep primary for 1h and then coordinate post-incident notes.
Maria C: thanks team. I'll stay reachable if you need deep-dives. posting a short TO-DO: 1) confirm model rollback triggers, 2) run regression eval on sample prompts, 3) link customers affected for CS outreach.
Aj P: added to incident checklist and rotation sheet: https://docs.redwood.com/ops/oncall-rotation (noted swap).
Devon R: I'll publish status page draft in 10m if metrics hold: "Partial degradation in EU region; mitigation in progress".
Maria C: ack. leaving channel now. :wave:
Devon R: ack and thanks. I'll keep this thread updated and file postmortem tomorrow. :thumbsup:
